title: Bhagare baingan: aubergines with coconut, chilli, tamarind and curry leaves

source.title: Vegetarian coconut curry recipes: Maunika Gowardhan's spicy aubergine baingan and spiced vegetable stew

ingredients.name: Vegetable oil
ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp for the paste, 4 tbsp for the gravy

instructions: For the paste, soak the poppy seeds in 70ml warm water for 20 minutes. Fry the chopped onion in 2 tbsp oil in a small pan for 8 to 9 minutes, until it starts to colour, add the sesame seeds and coconut and fry for 2 minutes. Cool, stir in the poppy seeds and their water, and blitz smooth.
Blitz the tomatoes to a puree. Grind the garlic to a paste and slit the aubergines lengthways.

In a large heavy frying pan with a lid, heat 4 tbsp oil over a medium heat and fry the sliced onions, stirring often, for 17 to 18 minutes, until soft and lightly browned. Add the garlic paste for 20 seconds, then the turmeric, chilli powder and cumin for a few seconds, until fragrant.
Add the tomato puree and fry, stirring, for 5 minutes, until it splits and the oil separates. Add the onion and poppy seed paste and fry, stirring all the time, for 4 minutes.
Pour in 350ml warm water, season, stir in the aubergines, cover and simmer on low for about 15 minutes, stirring once halfway. Add the tamarind and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Off the heat, stir in the black pepper, dried chillies and curry leaves. Garnish with coriander and serve with roti or rice.
